blockers.requirement: After creating or initializing the same ZSTD_DStream and before decoding a magicless frame, select ZSTD_f_zstd1_magicless with ZSTD_DCtx_setFormat so ZSTD_decompressStream can exercise the new supported format.
blockers.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput creates and initializes dstream, makes input/output buffers from fuzz bytes, and calls ZSTD_decompressStream on that same object.
blockers.failure_condition: The entry leaves format at ZSTD_f_zstd1. A valid magicless frame lacks the standard four-byte magic, so the default parser returns an error and the target exits the decoding loop without executing the magicless branch.
blockers.alternative_paths: Input bytes cannot alter dstream->format. The complete entry has no format setter; its init and reset calls do not select magicless format. The generic decoder delegates to the same stream operation, and the separate magicless test is not this entry.
